source_binding: Both complete storage race suites, policy, and package lint bind all five committed Go files. The final prose check binds the generated storage README and store contract.
limits: The two original regression tests failed because Memory did not implement collection and generation read leases. The new interface declarations already existed during that failure. This proves the absent capability, not a prior incorrect deletion.

RetainingStore adds optional AcquireGeneration and Collect methods without changing Store. Memory implements the role. Filesystem, object storage, shared application adapters, and runtime adoption remain incomplete.

Each request supplies positive generation and byte limits and the expected current generation. Every required ID must exist. Current, caller-required generations, and active leases survive collection, including when their bytes or count exceed the limit.

The default scan limit is 4096 entries. An explicit pass permits at most 100000 entries. Incomplete scans, missing requirements, invalid limits, cancellation, and stale current produce refusal before deletion.

Oldest generated content leaves first, with generation ID as the deterministic equal-time tie break. This is generation time, not activation order. Byte totals count manifest and payload bytes, not filesystem overhead, journals, or replication.
Dry runs preserve all content and report candidates and projected usage. Normal reports identify applied removals. OverLimit reports protected content that exceeds capacity.

Read leases return independent payload and manifest bytes. Release is idempotent, remains usable after context cancellation, and cannot end another caller lease. Collection serializes with publication under the memory store lock.
Both complete storage suites pass 112 test events, including parents, without failures or skips. The suites repeat the same cases on two Go toolchains. They do not supply 224 distinct cases.

Package lint and goago pass. The first prose check reached the glossary candidate threshold for two repeated terms. Revised wording preserves meaning without changing glossary policy. The final source prose check passes.
These macOS results do not qualify native Windows or Linux behavior. The new role does not enable automatic collection or prove persistent recovery.

The separately running required suite uses clean c8ec797a and excludes this retention change. Preserve its terminal result before removing the temporary checkout. It gives no complete CSP5 acceptance credit.

Persistent generation collection, observation-file collection, distinct-inventory retirement, twelve mapped task subcases, complete verification, review, native CI, and merge remain open. CSP5 remains unpublished until its full contract passes.
Five concurrent tooling edits remain outside this commit. Final task qualification must use the committed module graph.
The final canonical prose check passes. Source snapshots separate the concurrent tooling edits from six owned documentation files. Task criteria, scope, invariants, and the goal remain unchanged.

The first canonical prose check found two long paragraphs and two long sentences. Paragraph breaks and sentence splits preserve all facts. The failed check and its source snapshots remain in this proof.
